pages.name: national_statistical_office
pages.title: Part 3 - National Statistical Office
pages.description: Please answer the following questions about the national statistical office in your country. Concise but informative responses are sufficient. If an issue is not applicable, please briefly explain why.

elements.name: organization_q1
elements.title: Please describe how the National Statistical Office is organized. What are its main units and subunits, what are their responsibilities and how are they staffed? Are there any local offices? If so, what are their responsibilities and how are they staffed?

elements.name: financial
elements.title: Please describe the financial resources available to the National Statistical Office. What is/are the process(es) that determine these resources? Are the financial resources of the NSO and the broader national statistical system sufficient to reach the objectives set out in the current National Strategy for the Development of Statistics?

elements.name: recruitment
elements.title: Please describe the process(es) through which the National Statistical Office recruits its staff. Does/do this/these process(es) ensure that the NSO is staffed at the levels of knowledge and experience required?

elements.name: retention
elements.title: Please indicate if, and if so to what extent, the retention of staff is a challenge for the National Statistical Office. In case it is, are any measures in place to limit the undesirable high staff turnover rate?

elements.name: training
elements.title: Please describe the process(es) through which the National Statistical Office trains and develops its staff. Does/do this/these process(es) ensure that the NSO staff continuously develop the knowledge and experience required to produce high quality official statistics?

elements.name: ict
elements.title: Please describe the ICT resources available to the National Statistical Office, both in terms of hardware and software. Are these resources sufficient to reach the objectives set out in the current National Strategy for the Development of Statistics?

elements.name: dissemination_q1
elements.title: Please describe the dissemination policy and practices of the National Statistical Office. Apart from having its website, is the NSO active on platforms such as Facebook, X, BlueSky, Instagram or LinkedIn? Does the NSO have an advance release calendar? Are all users given access to newly released statistics and/or revisions simultaneously?

elements.name: stakeholder_consultation
elements.title: Relations and communication with main stakeholders

elements.name: stakeholder_consultation_q1
elements.title: How does the National Statistical Office communicate and otherwise maintain relations with stakeholders such as other government entities, businesses, academia, media, and the public? Is there a mechanism in place to consult stakeholders on (evolving) user demand and the annual programme of work?

elements.name: international_relations_q1
elements.title: Please describe the support that the National Statistical Office is currently receiving, and has been receiving over the last five years, from international development partners.
